resources.title: NIST Quantum Information Science
resources.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.notes: Authoritative U.S. metrology and quantum-information research reference.

resources.title: IBM Quantum Documentation
resources.notes: Practical quantum-computing documentation; use alongside physics texts for formal foundations.

resources.title: Quantum Algorithm Zoo
resources.notes: Reference index of quantum algorithms and source literature.

resources.title: arXiv Quantum Physics
resources.notes: Research/preprint layer; distinguish preprints from peer-reviewed literature and preserve version/license metadata.

resources.title: University Physics Volume 3 — Quantum Mechanics
resources.notes: Structured introductory treatment includes wave functions, uncertainty, Schrodinger equation, particle in a box, harmonic oscillator, and tunneling; supports the lower-level ladder without pretending it is graduate research.

resources.title: 8.04 Quantum Physics I
resources.notes: MIT undergraduate quantum sequence course with formal wave mechanics, operators, time evolution, one-dimensional potentials, harmonic oscillator, scattering/resonances, and assessed problem material.

resources.title: 5.73 Quantum Mechanics I
resources.notes: Graduate MIT course covering operator/matrix methods, angular-momentum tensor methods and many-body systems; useful for deep study and worked assessment, not by itself an expert-status claim.

resources.title: NIST Atomic Spectra Database (SRD 78)
resources.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.notes: NIST Standard Reference Database 78 provides critically evaluated atomic energy levels, wavelengths and transition probabilities, giving quantum theory an authoritative experimental/reference-data validation layer.
